create_worksheet.description: Add a new worksheet (tab) to an existing workbook with optional default headers.

workbookId.description: The workbook ID. The choices list the OneDrive workbooks.

name.label: Worksheet Name
name.description: The name for the new worksheet. If not provided, a default name like 'Sheet1' will be assigned.

headers.label: Headers
headers.description: Optional: A list of headers to add to the first row, such as ["Name", "Email"]. A table will be created from these headers.

copy_worksheet.label: Copy Worksheet
copy_worksheet.description: Duplicate a worksheet into a new worksheet, in the same workbook or a different one. Copies values, formulas, and number formats.

folderId.label: Folder
folderId.description: The folder containing the workbook, which narrows the workbook choices. Leave empty to search the entire drive.

workbookId.label: Workbook
workbookId.description: The workbook ID. The choices list the OneDrive workbooks.

destinationWorkbookId.label: Destination Workbook
destinationWorkbookId.description: The workbook to copy the worksheet into. Leave empty to copy within the source workbook.

newWorksheetName.label: New Worksheet Name
newWorksheetName.description: The name for the copied worksheet. If left empty, Excel assigns a default name. The name must not be blank or exceed 31 characters, not contain any of / \ ? * : [ ], and be unique within the destination workbook, and not be the reserved name "History".

copyMode.label: Copy Mode
copyMode.description: Whether to copy the formulas (recalculated in the new sheet) or just the resulting values.
